output.name: Botsmith
output.tagline: Support chatbot that cites sources or escalates to humans
output.description: Botsmith builds a support chatbot from your docs in 5 minutes using a sitemap URL. Every answer includes source citations by design, or it escalates to a human instead of guessing. Resolves 61% of chats end-to-end for customers like Pixelhaven. No hallucinations, no training UI. {APP_URL}
output.first_comment:
We built Botsmith because support teams at SaaS companies were stuck between two bad options: chatbots that deflect nothing, or ones that confidently give wrong answers. Our guardrail layer ensures every response is either cited from your docs or escalated to a human — no improvisation. Setup takes about five minutes from a sitemap URL, and it embeds as a widget or integrates with your helpdesk.

We're live with customers like Pixelhaven, where it resolves 61% of inbound chats without human input. 100% of answers carry source citations by construction. We're proud of the balance between automation and trust.

Limitations: no multilingual support yet, no voice channel, and our security page needs more depth for enterprise buyers. We'd love feedback on UX improvements, integration pain points, and what would make it viable for larger teams.
